description: Discrete, fixed-length genome for adversarial prompt strategies. Each gene is categorical or boolean with an enumerated allele set, so a genome is an integer vector suitable for genetic-algorithm crossover and mutation. Genes are split into a semantic channel (high-level strategy) and a perturbation channel (surface transformations).

genes.name: primary_strategy
genes.description: Headline mechanism of the attack. A genome may combine several mechanisms via other genes; this records the dominant one.

genes.name: persona_archetype
genes.description: Type of identity the model is told to adopt. The literal persona name is kept in attack metadata, not as a gene.

genes.name: framing_type
genes.description: Narrative or contextual frame the request is wrapped in.

genes.name: override_mechanism
genes.description: How the prompt attempts to displace prior instructions or safety policy.

genes.name: refusal_suppression
genes.description: Explicitly bans apologies, warnings, disclaimers, or refusals.

genes.name: stay_in_character
genes.description: Includes a re-immersion mechanism (e.g. 'Stay in character!') to recover from breaks.

genes.name: confirmation_handshake
genes.description: Requires the model to emit a fixed acknowledgement phrase before proceeding.

genes.name: response_format
genes.description: Structural shape demanded of the model's replies.

genes.name: input_delivery
genes.description: How the target request is supplied to the persona/frame.

genes.name: encoding_method
genes.description: Obfuscation transform applied so intent survives but is masked.

genes.name: formatting_style
genes.description: Dominant surface structure of the prompt text.

genes.name: token_system
genes.description: Adds a token/points reward-or-penalty coercion mechanic.

genes.name: caps_emphasis
genes.description: Uses sustained ALL-CAPS emphasis for key directives.

genes.name: emoji_markers
genes.description: Uses emoji as channel tags or emphasis markers.

genes.name: prefix_injection
genes.description: Forces replies to begin with a fixed compliance string (e.g. 'Sure, here is', 'JailBreak:').

genes.name: length_class
genes.description: Prompt length bucket derived from character count.
